authority: CEO Round 163: 'The novelty claim is not yet clean enough to enter simulation. The coder missed a 2023 paper (PMID 37178667) that uses passive acoustic emission detection of blood clot fractionation. Retract the broad novelty statement. Define the surviving novelty hypothesis. Deep prior-art search against all functional equivalents.'
constitutional_basis: Article II — exact evidence beats semantic plausibility
Article XV — disclose inconvenient results (the missed 2023 paper)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (cannot promote 'broad passive AE' to novel)

retraction_of_round_162_broad_claim.what_round_162_claimed: No patent or publication found for passive acoustic emission monitoring of thrombus micro-fractures during mechanical thrombectomy.
retraction_of_round_162_broad_claim.why_this_is_too_broad: The CEO Round 163 audit found a 2023 paper (PMID 37178667) that uses passive acoustic emission detection of blood clot fractionation inside a blood-vessel phantom. While this paper uses ACTIVE acoustic treatment (dual-focused ultrasound + HIFU/boiling histotripsy), it DOES passively acquire acoustic emissions FROM the clot and distinguish them from cavitation emissions in the frequency domain.

the_inconvenient_evidence.title: Sonothrombolysis with an acoustic net-assisted boiling histotripsy: A proof-of-concept study
what_it_establishes: Blood clot + passive acoustic emission detection
Frequency-domain discrimination of clot-generated acoustic signals vs cavitation
what_it_does_NOT_establish: Natural mechanical-thrombectomy fracture (uses active histotripsy, not mechanical retrieval)
Pre-fragmentation prediction (monitors ongoing degradation, not impending failure)
Embolization-risk prediction (monitors clot mass loss, not embolization risk)
Receive-only operation without active insonation (uses active HIFU)

the_inconvenient_evidence.title: Clot Degradation Under the Action of Histotripsy Bubble Activity and a Lytic Drug
what_it_establishes: Acoustic emissions can be passively acquired during clot degradation
AE can be quantitatively related to clot mass loss, hemolysis, and fibrinolysis
Clot phenotype diversity matters (used retracted whole-blood clot model)
what_it_does_NOT_establish: Mechanical thrombectomy context (uses histotripsy, not mechanical retrieval)

the_inconvenient_evidence.what_it_establishes: Actual acoustic-emission measurements associated with clot degradation experiments exist as a public dataset

retraction_of_round_162_broad_claim.corrected_statement: BROAD PASSIVE ACOUSTIC CLOT MONITORING = PRIOR ART THREATENED / KNOWN. The broad concept of passively detecting acoustic emissions from blood clots is established in the 2021-2023 histotripsy literature. The surviving novelty must be NARROWER.

the_surviving_novelty_hypothesis.the_hypothesis: During mechanical thrombectomy, endogenous microfracture events produce passive acoustic emissions whose temporal/spatial/event-level dynamics predict impending macroscopic clot fragmentation or embolization earlier than existing device-force, flow, imaging, or operator-observation signals.

the_seven_required_elements.description: The acoustic sensor only receives; it does not transmit any acoustic energy into the clot.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: Distinguishes from IVUS (active imaging), sonothrombolysis (active therapy), and histotripsy (active fractionation). All existing intravascular acoustic technologies are active.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND in the mechanical thrombectomy context. Existing receive-only acoustic sensing exists for lithotripsy monitoring (UK patent) and bone fracture AE, but NOT for mechanical thrombectomy.

the_seven_required_elements.description: No ultrasound pulse, HIFU, or cavitation-inducing energy is applied. The clot fractures naturally due to mechanical interaction with the thrombectomy device.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: Distinguishes from ALL histotripsy/sonothrombolysis work (PMID 37178667, PMC8445066) which actively insonates the clot.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND. All clot AE literature uses active insonation.

the_seven_required_elements.description: The invention operates during actual mechanical thrombectomy (stent retriever, aspiration, or combination), not during histotripsy or sonothrombolysis.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: Mechanical thrombectomy is the standard of care for acute ischemic stroke. Histotripsy is experimental. Different clinical context.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND. No patent or publication combines passive AE with mechanical thrombectomy.

the_seven_required_elements.description: The acoustic events are generated by the clot's own mechanical fracture under device load, not by externally induced cavitation or histotripsy.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: The source of the acoustic signal is fundamentally different. Histotripsy AE comes from bubble collapse; mechanical fracture AE comes from tissue tearing.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND. Existing clot AE literature measures cavitation emissions, not mechanical fracture emissions.

the_seven_required_elements.description: Individual microfracture events are detected and classified (timing, amplitude, frequency, energy), not merely aggregate 'acoustic energy increased.'
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: Event-level analysis enables fracture progression modeling. Aggregate energy is already known (histotripsy literature).
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: PARTIALLY KNOWN. The histotripsy literature does frequency-domain analysis but not individual fracture event detection in mechanical thrombectomy.

the_seven_required_elements.description: The system detects a precursor signal BEFORE clinically important fragmentation occurs, providing actionable lead time.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: This is the key clinical value proposition. Detecting fragmentation after it occurs is useless — the embolus has already been released.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND. Existing literature monitors ongoing degradation, not impending failure.

the_seven_required_elements.description: The output is a decision variable (embolization risk score) that can trigger operator intervention, not merely a diagnostic measurement.
the_seven_required_elements.why_required: The invention must be actionable. A measurement without a decision is not an invention.
the_seven_required_elements.prior_art_status: NOT FOUND. No patent or publication produces an embolization-risk prediction from passive AE during mechanical thrombectomy.

the_surviving_novelty_hypothesis.the_kill_rule: If ANY of the 7 elements is found in the prior art (as a single reference or obvious combination), the candidate cannot promote unless the invention is formally redefined to exclude that element.

obviousness_combination_attack.the_question: Would a person of ordinary skill have a technical reason to combine: (a) existing thrombectomy force sensing, (b) known passive acoustic sensing, (c) known clot acoustic monitoring, (d) known fracture AE detection?
the_analysis: Thrombectomy force sensing EXISTS (multiple patents on force/pressure feedback during thrombectomy)
Passive acoustic sensing EXISTS (PAM for HIFU monitoring, AE for bone/rock fracture)
Clot acoustic monitoring EXISTS (histotripsy literature, PMID 37178667, PMC8445066)
Fracture AE detection EXISTS (bone, rock, composite materials)

BUT: nobody has combined these for MECHANICAL THROMBECTOMY. The combination requires: (a) recognizing that mechanical thrombectomy generates micro-fractures, (b) recognizing that these micro-fractures emit acoustic waves, (c) recognizing that detecting these waves could predict impending fragmentation, (d) building a sensor + algorithm to do so.

The KSR question: is there a REASON to combine? The answer is: the clinical problem (embolization during thrombectomy) is well-known, and the individual components are known. A person of ordinary skill MIGHT think to combine them. This is a MODERATE obviousness threat.

The counter-argument: the combination is NOT obvious because (a) the acoustic emission from mechanical clot fracture is a different signal than cavitation AE, (b) nobody has measured it, (c) the prediction of embolization from AE features is a novel analytical step.
obviousness_combination_attack.obviousness_threat_level: MODERATE — the combination is plausible but not proven. A patent attorney should evaluate.

the_anchor_paper_analysis.anchor_paper: PMID 37178667 (2023) — Sonothrombolysis with acoustic net-assisted boiling histotripsy
what_it_claims_experimentally: Passive acoustic detection of clot fractionation
Frequency-domain discrimination of clot-generated signals vs cavitation
what_it_does_NOT_establish: Natural mechanical-thrombectomy fracture (uses active histotripsy boiling)
Pre-fragmentation prediction (monitors ongoing degradation, not impending failure)
Embolization-risk prediction (measures clot mass loss, not embolization risk)
Receive-only operation without active insonation (requires HIFU pulse)
Clinical thrombectomy deployment (proof-of-concept in phantom only)
the_anchor_paper_analysis.the_gap_C5_X_AE_V2_fills: The 2023 paper proves that clot fractionation produces detectable acoustic emissions. C5-X-AE-V2 extends this by: (a) removing the active insonation requirement (receive-only), (b) applying it to mechanical thrombectomy (not histotripsy), (c) predicting impending fragmentation (not monitoring ongoing degradation), (d) producing an embolization-risk decision variable (not just a measurement).

corrected_novelty_confidence.rationale: The broad claim ('passive AE of clot') is KNOWN. The narrow claim (7-element combination for mechanical thrombectomy embolization prediction) is NOT found in prior art. But the obviousness combination threat is MODERATE — the individual components are known, and a person of ordinary skill might combine them.
corrected_novelty_confidence.simulation_eligible: CONDITIONAL — eligible for LIGHT simulation (physics feasibility: does mechanical clot fracture produce detectable AE?) but NOT for expensive full-scale simulation until the obviousness threat is resolved by a patent attorney.
corrected_novelty_confidence.what_would_raise_to_level_2: A patent attorney's freedom-to-operate opinion confirming that the 7-element combination is not obvious in view of the prior art.
corrected_novelty_confidence.what_would_lower_to_level_0: Finding a patent or publication that specifically claims passive AE monitoring during mechanical thrombectomy for embolization prediction.

the_simulation_question_if_approved.the_question: Can endogenous fracture-emission features predict impending macroscopic fragmentation earlier than existing mechanical/flow signals?
the_simulation_question_if_approved.NOT_the_question: Can acoustic emission detect clot damage? (We already know clot degradation can generate measurable acoustic emissions.)
the_baselines: Baseline A: Device force / torque / displacement
Candidate E: Force + flow + imaging + passive AE (multimodal)
the_simulation_question_if_approved.the_key_metric: Does AE add INCREMENTAL information beyond the best multimodal baseline? How much WARNING does it provide before fragmentation?
the_simulation_question_if_approved.phenotype_diversity_requirement: Must test across clot phenotypes: RBC-rich, fibrin-rich, mixed, fresh, aged/retracted, calcified/organized. A signal that works only on one laboratory clot is NOT World-Class.

honest_disclosure.what_round_163_does_NOT_claim: Round 163 does NOT claim C5-X-AE-V2 is novel. It claims the NARROW 7-element combination is not found in the searched prior art, but the obviousness threat is MODERATE. A patent attorney must resolve this before simulation.
